stem.text: A potential divider circuit is constructed with one variable resistor X and one fixed resistor Y, as shown.

stem.alt: Potential divider circuit with a battery, a variable resistor labelled X with an arrow through it, and a fixed resistor labelled Y, with output terminals labelled VX and VY.

stem.text: The potential difference across resistor X is $V_\text{X}$ and the potential difference of resistor Y is $V_\text{Y}$.
As the resistance of X is increased, what happens to $V_\text{X}$ and to $V_\text{Y}$?
